interface.signature: shortestDistance(N: int, M: int, X: int, Y: int, A: List[List[int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: Matrix dimensions N and M are within the specified range.
Target coordinates (X, Y) are within the matrix bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i][j] <= 1 for i in range(N) for j in range(M))
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix A are either 0 or 1.
The starting cell (0,0) must contain a 1.

postconditions.description: If the starting cell (0,0) is 0, return -1. Otherwise, return a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of steps.
The returned value is either -1 (if no path exists) or the minimum number of steps required to reach (X,Y) from (0,0).
